paragraphs: I’m Michael, a Software Engineering student at Addis Ababa University, working toward my bachelor’s degree in 2030. My interests span full-stack development, machine learning, and computer vision.
At Addis Tech Group, I’m gaining practical experience building and improving web applications. Alongside that, I explore projects that connect software to everyday problems.

experience.description: Building and improving responsive web applications with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, with a focus on performance and maintainability.
Developing a foundation in software engineering while exploring practical applications in web development, machine learning, and computer vision.
